title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Gonzaga University
description: Ten under-21-safe Spokane food stops with current official hours extending to 11 p.m. or later. Confirm hours and service mode before leaving campus.

cards.title: Wendy's on Division
cards.subtitle: A 1 a.m. option south of campus
cards.notes: Check the official location page before leaving, then use the listed restaurant or drive-through service for a late meal.
cards.short_summary: A nearby chain stop with both restaurant and drive-through hours posted through 1 a.m. every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official location page identifies 830 North Division in Spokane and lists restaurant and drive-through hours of 6:30 a.m.–1 a.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Official current hours list the restaurant and drive-through open until 1:00 a.m. Monday–Sunday.

cards.title: Domino's on Hamilton
cards.subtitle: Pizza service beside the university district
cards.notes: Open the store page to confirm tonight's closing time, then choose carryout or delivery according to the ordering options shown.
cards.short_summary: A Hamilton Street pizza counter whose official page currently advertises service into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official store page identifies the 1320 North Hamilton Street location and states that it is open today until 2 a.m.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 1320 North Hamilton Street
cards.access_notes: The official store page currently says “Today Until 2:00 AM”; hours vary, so recheck the page before ordering.

cards.title: Jimmy John's on Mission
cards.subtitle: Sandwiches available through 11 p.m.
cards.notes: Order before the posted cutoff and select pickup, delivery, or indoor seating only when that option appears available on the store page.
cards.short_summary: A Mission Avenue sandwich shop with the same late closing time throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John's official location page identifies 105 E Mission Ave and lists store and delivery hours of 10:30 a.m.–11 p.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Sandwich Shop & Gourmet Subs in Spokane | Jimmy John's 1418
cards.access_notes: Official hours show the shop and delivery service operating until 11:00 p.m. Monday–Sunday.

cards.title: McDonald's on North Monroe
cards.subtitle: An 11 p.m. stop, with midnight drive-through weekends
cards.notes: Check whether you need lobby or drive-through access; Friday and Saturday have a later drive-through cutoff than other nights.
cards.short_summary: A North Monroe option with clearly separated lobby and drive-through schedules.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's official page identifies 1818 N Monroe and lists lobby hours through 11 p.m. daily, with drive-through service until midnight Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Spokane, WA at 1818 N Monroe | McDonald's
cards.access_notes: Lobby closes at 11:00 p.m. daily; the drive-through closes at midnight Friday–Saturday and 11:00 p.m. other nights.

cards.title: McDonald's on North Market
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour drive-through northeast of campus
cards.notes: Plan on drive-through access after the lobby closes, and verify the location page before making the longer nighttime trip.
cards.short_summary: A farther Spokane option whose official listing distinguishes a 24-hour drive-through from limited lobby access.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's official page identifies 3416 N Market St and lists its drive-through as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Spokane, WA at 3416 N Market St | McDonald's
cards.access_notes: The official page lists 24-hour drive-through service daily; the lobby is listed only until 11:00 p.m.

cards.title: Denny's on North Division
cards.subtitle: An overnight diner run north of campus
cards.notes: Review the live store schedule before departing; the page promotes 24/7 dining but also displays day-specific ordering times.
cards.short_summary: A sit-down diner option with an official page centered on round-the-clock breakfast and late dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official location page identifies 3525 North Division Street and describes the Spokane diner as serving breakfast, pancakes, skillets, and burgers 24/7.
cards.access_notes: The official page describes this location as serving food 24/7; consult its live day-specific store-hours panel before travel.

cards.title: The Satellite Diner
cards.subtitle: Downtown diner service until 2 a.m.
cards.notes: Use the diner entrance and confirm the posted schedule before traveling downtown; the business also operates an attached lounge.
cards.short_summary: A downtown diner serving breakfast and other meals late into the night seven days a week.
cards.evidence_claim: The Satellite's official website identifies 425 W Sprague Ave and lists diner hours until 2 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: The Satellite Diner & Lounge | Great Food & Drinks in Spokane
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 7:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. Monday–Friday and 8:00 a.m.–2:00 a.m. Saturday–Sunday; use the diner side.

cards.title: Taco Bell on North Division
cards.subtitle: Drive-through service until 3 a.m.
cards.notes: Treat this as a drive-through run after the dining room closes, and verify the day's service hours on the official location page.
cards.short_summary: A late drive-through option well north of campus, with dine-in access ending much earlier.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official page identifies 6614 N Division St and lists drive-through hours through 3 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurant Near Me in Spokane, WA
cards.access_notes: Official drive-through hours are 7:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m. daily; the page shows dine-in closing at 10:00 p.m.

cards.title: Osprey by the Spokane River
cards.subtitle: Dinner service until 11 p.m. on later nights
cards.notes: Choose restaurant seating and arrive before the kitchen winds down; check the posted schedule because only Thursday–Saturday reach 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A riverfront restaurant adjacent to Gonzaga with a later Thursday-through-Saturday closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Osprey's official website identifies 700 North Division Street, says it is adjacent to Gonzaga University, and lists Thursday–Saturday hours through 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 7:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. Thursday–Saturday and 7:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. Sunday–Wednesday; use restaurant seating.

cards.title: Tomato Street on North Division
cards.subtitle: A family restaurant open until 11 p.m. on weekends
cards.notes: Save this for Friday or Saturday, when the restaurant stays open later, and confirm current hours before driving north.
cards.short_summary: A family-oriented Italian restaurant whose weekend schedule extends to 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Tomato Street's official locations page identifies the Spokane restaurant at 6220 N Division St, describes it as a family Italian restaurant, and lists Friday–Saturday hours through 11 p.m.
cards.source_title: Locations & Hours | Tomato Street Italian Restaurant
cards.access_notes: The official location listing gives Friday–Saturday hours of 11:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m.; earlier closing applies on other days.
